title: AARO found SOM 1-01 crash-packaging manual

tellings.quote: They found like this this manual which talks about like packaging and unpackaging debris and craft and bodies from an extraterrestrial vehicle crash

plain: AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate UAP (the official term for UFOs), is said to have found a manual known as SOM 1-01 that explains how to pack and unpack debris, craft and bodies from an extraterrestrial vehicle crash. A guest who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells Michels this, passing on what he says he heard and naming Tim Phillips and Sean Kirkpatrick in connection with it. If true, it would mean the US government once wrote standard procedures for handling crashed alien craft and their crews.
